about: Rules a project may already carry that the warm-up standard replaces. `/warmup --migrate` moves a rule only when its bold lead matches an entry here, and moves it verbatim into a dated block of docs/OPERATING-RULES.md's ## Superseded section -- never deletes it. A rule no entry matches is left where it is: migrate does not guess which rules still hold. Add an entry when a migration shows a rule the standard replaces, citing where it was seen.

rules.replaced_by: the ledger, docs/proposals/NN-*.json, is the plan of record; its page is generated by tracker render
rules.reason: a hand-kept plan page and its data drifted; the ledger is validated, rendered and gated by land

rules.replaced_by: tracker render draws every bar from the ledger's statuses; the page carries a digest and --check says when it is stale
rules.reason: bars updated by hand after merges were right only as often as someone remembered; the status line was asked for eleven times in one session
